adjudication.rationale: Looking at packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts lines 5-15, when APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED is true and CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT is set, the function makes a fetch request and returns the response directly without checking response.ok or the HTTP status code. If the endpoint returns a 4xx or 5xx error, this raw error response will be passed to the calling code which expects valid token data. The calling code in various CalendarService files (e.g., GoogleCalendarService, Office365CalendarService) then attempts to parse this response as token data, which would fail or produce incorrect behavior. This is a real bug where error responses are not properly handled.
